title: Magnetic orthogonal modular forms
summary: In this note we show that certain meromorphic orthogonal modular forms are magnetic, i.e.\ their Fourier coefficients satisfy special divisibility criteria. These meromorphic orthogonal modular forms are counterparts to the orthogonal cusp forms considered by Oda. We show that the seminal of work of Borcherds implies the magneticity of these forms.
